name: api-explorer
description: Explores and analyzes OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, lists endpoints, models, and detects API frameworks

envVars.name: API_EXPLORER_ENDPOINTS
envVars.description: JSON array of OpenAPI endpoints to explore, e.g. [{"alias":"api","url":"http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs"}]. Without it the server starts but has no endpoints configured.
